limitations: Real native CLI terminals and published MCP packages were driven by deterministic local model responses. This is not hosted-model, GUI or usability evidence.
Fresh unfunded wallets signed offline only. RPC/REST used disabled loopback endpoints; no chain or provider resources were created.
The minimal offline config omits converterAddress and faucetUrl, so CosmWasm is unavailable and the faucet tool is absent. Read-only chain list_modules passed.
Saved schema 2/3 manifests, draft and journal are synthetic fixtures. Live deployments and their records are covered in the separate 0.5.0 testnet report.

Legacy upgrade was tested from tagged 0.4.0 using native remove/reinstall with the same plugin identity, preserving Claude data with --keep-data. Native marketplace update-in-place and other legacy versions were not tested.
The explicit file credential backend proves local migration and preservation; it does not prove OS-store access or cross-machine portability.

The first Claude 0.5.0 upgrade session exceeded its native 30-second MCP connection timeout during automatic runtime installation. The failed connection remained cached after restart; native /mcp → manifest-chain → Reconnect restored it. Policy and public startup diagnostics remained visible.
